content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that reproduces the Still-Gennari reaction retrosynthetically. Input molecule? Not given directly but from previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 answer [] meaning applying some template gave no precursors. We need to find template that when applied to molecule reproduces reaction. The target molecule likely is product of Still-Gennari: a Z-alkene with ester? The description: carbon-carbon double bond and carboxylic ester formed, broken: carbon-phosphorus bond, carbon-carbon bond, carbon-oxygen bond, triple bond changed to single. So starting material likely an alkyne and a phosphonate ester? The product maybe something like C=CC(=O)O (acrylic acid?) Actually Still-Gennari forms Z-alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate ester. Product is alkene with ester group (phosphonate becomes ester). Example: aldehyde R-CHO + phosphonate (RO)2P(O)CH2-COOR' gives (Z)-alkene R-CH=CH-COOR'. So product is an α,β-unsaturated ester. The SMILES maybe "C=CC(=O)O" (acrylic acid). That's what we used. So need template that transforms acrylic acid back to aldehyde + phosphonate. So we need to search templates that break C-C double bond and form C-C triple? Actually reverse: forward forms double bond, breaks C-P, C-C, C-O, changes alkyne to single. So retrosynthesis: break double bond to alkyne and phosphonate? So template likely includes functional_groups_broken: C-C double bonds, functional_groups_formed: C-C triple bonds, phosphonate? Not in list. But we can search by bonds? Might be easier: use search with functional_groups_broken ["C-C double bonds"] and formed ["C-C triple bonds","phosphates"?]. Not available. Maybe template ID known? Could be template for HWE reaction. Could try search with functional_groups_broken ["C-C double bonds"] and formed ["C-C triple bonds"].
